report.state_of_the_book:
As of 1 July 2026 the book holds 60 episodes: 34 in exception, 15 closed, 11 pending. The exception set carries $749,716.90 expected against $443,203.53 received, a variance of $424,387.21, and 26 of those 34 were reopened from a prior disposition [[overview:by_disposition.EXCEPTION]]. Closed episodes show $192,874.63 expected against $200,968.01 received, a negative variance of $14,667.90, none reopened [[overview:by_disposition.CLOSED]]. Pending stands at $133,600.42 expected, $56,699.24 received and a variance of $76,901.18 [[overview:by_disposition.PENDING]].

The reason cited most often is a four-way tie: awaiting remittance, denied, no cash, and rebate rejected at four episodes each [[overview:reason_codes]]. Insufficient data appears on two episodes [[overview:reason_codes]]. Cross-track flags appear across seven codes, three episodes at the two most common [[overview:cross_track_flags]].
report.what_is_concentrated:

E-000022 and E-000019 lead at zero variance — both closed, both reopened on a clawed-back rebate [[queue:E-000022]] [[queue:E-000019]] — followed by E-000027 at -$6,638.63 on a duplicate payment [[queue:E-000027]], E-000030 at zero on a cash mismatch, then E-000047 and E-000006 again [[queue:E-000030]].
